definition: Optimal feasible quality x means x belongs to the fixed candidate set and its quality is IsGreatest in the image of that set. Quality has a Mathlib PartialOrder; no linearity, cardinal metric or injectivity is assumed. Candidates may be absent at the selected world. IsGreatest concerns quality values, not candidate identity.
note: Analyst-defined diagnostic for the selected-effect frontier. Not a historical attribution or independently established metaphysical premise. See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md.
